market_summary: Both GBPUSD and BTCUSD display mixed or conflicting signals during the London session. GBPUSD is trapped inside its session Value Area with bearish CVD diverging from an intrabar bounce. BTCUSD trades below session VAL and VWAP, but lacks volume confirmation as it hovers immediately above key session support levels (73386.8 / 73313.1), warranting a patient HOLD across both assets.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7 confluence factors: 1) Volume Profile: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.32531 to VAH 1.32729) and closing above POC 1.32577, suggesting potential mean-reverting chop within value. 2) CVD is BEARISH (-3091.86, slope -827.86), directly diverging from the upward bounce toward VAH. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION, generally active but lacking unified direction here. 4) Trend: Last close 1.32664 sits right on EMA50 (1.32687) and slightly above VWAP (1.32649), caught between trendlines. 5) ATR: Mid-to-upper channel test with ATR expanding, but approaching VAH resistance. 6) RVOL: Normal volume (1.123), no yellow spike confirming an expansion above VAH. 7) S/R: Testing local S/R 1.32661 with Session High at 1.32809 capping upside. Conflicting signals between bearish delta and bullish price push inside Value Area mandate a disciplined HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral consolidating around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7 confluence factors: 1) Volume Profile: Price is below VAL (73427.34) and below POC (73549.74), indicating session value breakdown. 2) CVD is BEARISH (-0.03, slope flat), aligning with downside structure. 3) Session: LONDON_SESSION. 4) Trend: Clear structural downtrend; price is consistently below both declining VWAP (73650.19) and EMA50 (73704.29). 5) ATR: Consolidating near lower ATR band (73210.26) with contracting volatility. 6) RVOL: Low volume (0.297) with no yellow spike, suggesting the breakdown below VAL lacks strong climactic expansion and risks a low-liquidity bear trap/sweep ahead of Session Low (73313.10) and S/R (73386.80). 7) S/R: Hovering directly on top of key support cluster (73386.80 S/R and 73313.10 Session Low), leaving poor room for a short without a confirmed high-volume breakdown. A disciplined HOLD is required until support resolves.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish holding below downward VWAP and EMA50
